### SFRS(I) Accounting Assessment: Customer lunch expense payment

**Authority Status**: **⚠️ Conditional Proposal**

#### 1. Accounting Treatment Principle
Under SFRS(I), business entertaining expenses are recognized as operating expenses in profit or loss when incurred.Do not assume input GST on customer or supplier meals is always claimable. The available evidence does not establish this case’s eligibility without the facts below. Before assessing a claim, confirm: Supplier and customer GST registration status, where relevant; Business or private use and supporting tax invoice for the GST claim; GST registration status of the company.

---

> ⚠️ **Uncertified Journal Proposal**: Account selections proposed by AI. Monetary amounts are uncalculated because required transaction values were not provided. Do not post to general ledger without independent valuation.
